findings.text: §13's Why states the problem as "any one moved directory sends the read back to a full walk" and the section is titled "A changed directory re-scans only itself", but the deliverable changes only `build_index`'s no-covered-set path; `reckon/serve.py:1278` reads its covered set through `_covered_files_for_project` -> `_covered_files` -> `_reuse_covered`, which still returns None on any moved directory and falls back to `_walk_covered` (reckon/metadata_index.py:707-713), so a cold `/_discover` read and the change-stream signature still walk all 2,505 directories — the served log shows `/_changes/reckon` at 184731.4 ms and `/_index/reckon` at 155336.1 ms
